name: Fibonacci Golden Zone Retracement [Manual Build]
raw_text: Fibonacci Golden Zone Retracement (New Batch 4, Strategy 2). Single timeframe: 1H (per the source). Fib levels (38.2/50/61.8%) drawn on the most recent alternating swing-low-to-swing-high (uptrend) or swing-high-to-swing-low (downtrend) leg (reuses swing_points()/support_resistance() directly, no new pivot logic). Long: uptrend leg, price retraces into the 50%-61.8% zone. Short: downtrend leg, price retraces into the mirrored 50%-61.8% band (source's own '61.8% zone' wording for shorts). Invalidation: a close past the 61.8% level against the trade direction invalidates that leg until a genuinely new leg forms (groupby+cummax state machine, same shape as order_block_validity()). SL = slightly beyond the 61.8% level (0.65% buffer, cost_model-verified safe). TP = NOT specified by source -- own default, structure-based (opposite swing point), same honest-default pattern used elsewhere in this codebase. Risk 1% default, no session restriction.
